Featuring @AshsDen, @Cayceee, @DubiousDuckling 

Unlike most of my projects, this game is actually just a map with a few command blocks, no data pack or anything. Haven't released it, not sure how if/when I will, but here's the basic command setup:

1. Create a hider team:
/team add hider

2. Add this command to a purple Repeating Command Block, and make sure it's powered:
effect give @a[team=hider] invisibility 1 0 true

3. Add this command in a cyan Chain Command Block connected to the Repeating Command Block:
execute as @a[team=hider] unless predicate {type:entity_properties,entity:this,predicate:{"type_specific/player":{input:{forward:0,backward:0,left:0,right:0,jump:0}}}} run effect clear @s invisibility

4. All players who wish to hide need to be added to the hider team:
/team join hider your_username_here

Three college kids just wanted to knock rival Minecraft servers offline. Instead, they blacked out Twitter, Netflix, and PayPal across the entire East Coast.

It hunted the internet's weakest, most forgotten devices: webcams, DVRs, and baby monitors still running factory default passwords. Paras Jha and his friends infected hundreds of thousands of them, then aimed the entire swarm at Dyn, the DNS provider that acts like the phone book of the web. When Dyn went down, half the internet went dark with it.

The lesson every developer should remember: the biggest DDoS attack in history wasn't built from power — it was built from the devices you forgot were plugged in.
